name: Security Health Check
description: A daily security check in your Magento admin: end-of-life and unpatched Magento or PHP versions, Composer packages with known vulnerabilities, and risky admin and configuration settings, each with a plain-English fix. Score out of 100, admin notice, email report and a CLI command for deployment pipelines.
shortDescription: Daily Magento security check: outdated versions, vulnerable packages and risky settings

features.title: Outdated and end-of-life versions
features.text: Tells you when your Magento release line or PHP version stops getting security fixes, and when a newer security patch for your version is out.

features.title: Known vulnerabilities, matched to your exact version
features.text: Checks your Magento version and every Composer package against the Packagist security advisory database, with the CVE, severity and the command to fix it.

features.title: Admin hardening (PCI DSS 8.x)
features.text: Two-factor authentication, a custom admin URL, no 'admin' username, lockout after failed logins, 15-minute sessions, CAPTCHA and secret keys in admin URLs.

features.title: Risky configuration
features.text: Production mode, HTTPS on every store view, Content Security Policy, template hints and cron health.

features.title: Score, admin notice and email report
features.text: A health score out of 100 with a fix for every issue, an admin notice for serious problems, and an email when something new appears plus a weekly or daily summary.

features.title: Private by design, CI friendly
features.text: Only package names are sent to public data sources; versions and settings stay on your server. bin/magento meetmage:security:check --fail-on=high can stop a deployment.
